findings.statement: Early finite-pool curvature gives useful gas-volume forecasts but loses to the strongest matched kernel; plausible two-pool curves are not unique microbial explanations.
findings.applicability: Whole DG runs link all protocols/flasks/horizons; metric averages protocol×run RMSE, not individual flask independence.
findings.limitations: The compact model fails the frozen 5 %all-baseline gate. Slow-pool times reach 500 h; prefix-exact agreement does not identify biological pools.
falsification: Use only 4/8 h prefixes and preserve whole DG run links across protocols.
Check monotonicity/asymptotes only for equations that explicitly claim them; do not score imposed prefix agreement as evidence.
Report total-gas units and reject methane/animal-benefit claims without corresponding measurements.
findings.prior_art: Finite-pool and time-varying-rate models have explicit prior art; no new biological principle is admitted. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.
